paper_title: Search for Dark Photon Dark Matter in the Mass Range $74\mbox{--}110\,μ\mathrm{eV}/c^2$ with a Cryogenic Millimeter-Wave Receiver
suggested_experiment_name: DOSUE-RR (Dark Photon Search Using Electromagnetic Receiver - Refined)
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing χ (dimensionless), plotted as χ × 10^-10 on y-axis
notes: Direct search for dark photon dark matter using cryogenic millimeter-wave receiver. Frequency range 18–26.5 GHz corresponds to mass range 74–110 µeV/c². No significant signal observed. Upper bounds χ < (0.3–2.0)×10⁻¹⁰ at 95% CL. This is the first exploration of this mass range by direct search and tighter than cosmological constraints. The coupling values represent the approximate range across the mass interval; the paper provides a continuous limit curve in Fig. 5 but the abstract and text quote the range (0.3–2.0)×10⁻¹⁰. Data points encode this as a two-point horizontal band spanning the mass range. Dark matter density ρ = 0.39 ± 0.03 GeV/cm³ used in signal power calculation (Eq. 1).
